rationale: The proposal includes all 85 exact authored boards from my quality-reviewed candidate, with no exclusions. Each derived catalog ID recomputes from its game, source and payload, and the audit replays map one-to-one to those IDs. The 45 Intrusul boards preserve their predicates and outsiders, such as the rail trio of Tren, Tramvai and Metrou with Bicicletă outside it. The 40 Perechi boards preserve all four match predicates and distinct tiles per board. The frozen core payload binding is unchanged. For each board, the native audit records selection through the public category-and-seed entry point, stable initial resume, hidden outsider and unsolved pair predicates, a 1000-point win, and retained terminal score on GET. All 460 HTTP requests are accounted for by the 85 replays. The candidate, initial quality review, proposal and audit hashes bind this acceptance to the exact reviewed content and observed results.
